'''Stefan Yuryevich Nemirovski''' ({{langx|ru|Стефан Юрьевич Немировский}}; born 29 July 1973) is a Russian [[mathematician]]. He made notable contributions to [[topology]] and [[complex analysis]], and was awarded an [[EMS Prize]] in 2000.<ref>[http://www.ams.org/notices/200009/people.pdf EMS Prize Laudatio, Notices AMS]</ref>

Nemirovski earned his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] from [[Moscow State University]] in 1998.
